svg.title: Encore Moment target architecture and technology stack
svg.desc: A desktop camera and microphone capture the audience. Sampled inputs are analysed by the server. The OPEN, UPDATE and FINAL recording signals tell the PC which buffered footage to save. The server target is Kubernetes; the initial deployment target is Docker Compose on Amazon EC2. Optional RDS history stores finalized event metadata.
svg.metadata: Diagram layout exported from Visual Paradigm VPasCode. Brand marks identify their respective products.
